== deck 0 spectre
// t

simulator lang=spectre

parameters p=1k q=2 r=3
statistics {
    process {
        vary p dist=gauss std=10 percent=yes
        vary q dist=lnorm std=100m
        vary r dist=unif N=200m
    }
    mismatch {
        vary q dist=gauss std=50m
    }
}

subckt s (a b)
r1 (a b) resistor r=q*1k
ends s

r1 (a 0) resistor r=p
x1 (a 0) s

== deck 5 ngspice
* t
.param w=1u
.param l=2u

.subckt s1 a b PARAMS: m=w__mm*2
.param l__mm_r={aunif(l, 20m)}
.param l__mm=l__mm_r
.param w__mm_r={agauss(w, 10m, 1)}
.param w__mm=w__mm_r
R1 a b {w__mm*1meg+l__mm*1meg}
.ends s1

.subckt s2 a b
R1 a b 1k
.ends s2

.subckt s3 a b
.param w__mm_r={agauss(w, 10m, 1)}
.param w__mm=w__mm_r
X1 a b s1 m=w__mm
.ends s3
X1 a 0 s1
X2 a 0 s2
.end

new: W0003
== deck 5 spectre
// t

simulator lang=spectre

parameters w=1u l=2u
statistics {
    mismatch {
        vary w dist=gauss std=10m
        vary l dist=unif N=20m
    }
}

subckt s1 (a b)
parameters m=w*2
r1 (a b) resistor r=w*1meg+l*1meg
ends s1

subckt s2 (a b)
r1 (a b) resistor r=1k
ends s2

subckt s3 (a b)
x1 (a b) s1 m=w
ends s3

x1 (a 0) s1
x2 (a 0) s2

== deck 5 vacask
t

ground 0

load "spice/resistor.osdi"

model resistor sp_resistor

parameters w=1u l=2u

subckt s1 (a b)
parameters m=w__mm*2
parameters l__mm=aunif(l, 20m) w__mm=agauss(w, 10m, 1)
  r1 (a b) resistor r=w__mm*1meg+l__mm*1meg
ends

subckt s2 (a b)
  r1 (a b) resistor r=1e3
ends

subckt s3 (a b)
parameters w__mm=agauss(w, 10m, 1)
  x1 (a b) s1 $mfactor=w__mm
ends

x1 (a 0) s1
x2 (a 0) s2

control
  options rawfile="binary"
endc

simulator lang=spectre


library lib
section tt
parameters v=1 v=2
statistics {
    process {
        vary v dist=gauss std=100m
    }
}
statistics {
    process {
        vary v dist=unif N=100m
    }
    mismatch {
        vary v dist=gauss std=10m
    }
}
ends tt
section ss
ends ss
endlibrary
subckt s (a b)
r1 (a b) resistor r=v
ends s
endsection tt
endlibrary lib
